messages.subject: hyperSpec: Student wanted
parts:
Dear all,

unfortunately, both students that were interested in contributing to
my R package found that they won't have enough time this year.
So hyperSpec is still without student.

@ the students here: if you are wondering what the project is about
and whether it would be interesting for you to contribute, it is about
data analysis of spectroscopic data sets.
Please look at the project page: hyperspec.r-forge.r-project.org it
does link to an already quite detailed idea list on the R Wiki.

@ the mentors: Looking at the proposals we have, I'm afraid they are
all quite far from my expertise. So I doubt I can help as a co- or
backup mentor.

Best regards,

Claudia
